about: Holdout for the junk filter fix (assistant-authored synthetic, written 2026-11-03 after the tricky.json results and before the fix ran on anything; never trained or tuned on). Same invented user as modern-dev.json. Wanted mail from strangers that looks like junk on the surface (code-only subjects, bare or urgent attachments, senders on mail.com / email.com / ymail.com, domains with 'cloud' or 'apply' in them) and unwanted mail at the edge of what the filter catches (code-subject lures with and without an urgent mark, an urgent zip, an HTML attachment). Labels are the author's.
